title: Rumsfeld admits trillions missing in audit day before 9/11
summary: Ross Coulthart tells of Rumsfeld admits trillions missing in audit day before 9/11, about 2001-09-10 at Washington, D.C., and reports it citing named sources. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I actually dug it out when I was writing my book that Donald Rumsfeld admitted that there was something

plain: An Australian journalist, Ross Coulthart, says that while writing his book he tracked down a speech by Donald Rumsfeld, then the US Secretary of Defense, given on 10 September 2001, the day before the September 11 attacks. Coulthart says Rumsfeld admitted in it that trillions of dollars could not be accounted for in Pentagon audits, which he brings up as a hint that huge sums could flow into hidden programmes.
